test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Nonetheless**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses the reality of child prodigies and how they are perceived versus the actual impact they make in history.
 
• The sentence before the blank mentions that these children thrive everywhere, their parents are happy, and their peers envy them.
 
• "**Nonetheless**" fits well here as it introduces a contrast, indicating that despite these positive perceptions, research shows they rarely change history.
 
• Other options ("**So that**", "**Which**", "**Neither**") do not fit logically in the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.
